protocol.name: waylandx_unstable_v1

description.summary: X11-style window powers for Wayland clients

protocol.description: Gives Wayland toplevels what X11 windows always had: choosing their own position, stacking layer, stickiness and taskbar visibility. WaylandX runs in an open (X11-like) trust model, so any client may use it.

request.name: get_toplevel_control

description.summary: get the control object for an xdg_toplevel

request.description: Only one control object may exist per toplevel at a time.

request.name: set_position

description.summary: move the window, in global layout coordinates

request.description: Coordinates are of the window content (excluding server-side decorations). Applies immediately if mapped, otherwise at map.

description.summary: current content position in layout coordinates
